# QA-001 Supplier Quality and NCR

## 1. Non-conformance reports

### 1.1 Raising an NCR

Quality inspectors raise a non-conformance report (NCR) when incoming product fails inspection. The supplier has 10 business days to respond with a corrective action plan.

## 2. Supplier scorecards

Scorecards are reviewed quarterly by the Quality Manager.
